command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== boot id baseline =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime -s || true
echo "== current sysctl values (pre-change) =="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route 2>&1 || true

command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== pre-restart boot id =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "== scheduling reboot in background so ack returns =="
sudo -n sh -c 'nohup sh -c "sleep 2 && reboot" >/tmp/reboot.log 2>&1 &'
echo "reboot scheduled"

set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "reboot scheduled"
